items.title: Tensoring with a fixed module commutes with arbitrary colimits
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that tensoring with a fixed module commutes with arbitrary colimits in the category of modules on a ringed space (author lemma at source lines 2623-2633, label lemma-tensor-commute-colimits). The proof (source lines 2635-2654) rewrites both the colimit and the tensor product as sheafifications of presheaves of sections, commutes the colimit into the tensor product at the level of sections by the algebraic statement, and concludes from the description of colimits of modules (proof lines 2636-2653). The reduction to the presheaf level is the content. H2.
